title: In 2006, New York couple lost newborn daughter; today, their foundation has trained 6,500 physicians
summary_full: Founded in 2006, the R Baby Foundation emerged to improve emergency care for children after the tragic loss of Rebecca Rabinowitz. Over two decades, it has successfully generated $18 million and trained over 6,500 doctors in more than 1,000 hospitals. The foundation recently hosted a gala event, raising nearly $2 million to support both its mission and the COPE Foundation, which provides vital resources for families coping with loss.
